warnings: B3's and B4's elevation details each print a typical section applying to TWO different span instances of the same mark drawn end-to-end (e.g. B3's '4.00' and '3.00' segments) for economy of drawing — this is one shared spec for the mark, not one continuous 7m beam; matches this house's grid, where B3 occurs at multiple different span lengths.

B3 and B4 both print additional top bars at interior supports beyond their continuous top bars (B3: +2-Ø12mm; B4: +2-Ø16mm and +2-Ø12mm together) — recorded as additional_bars (negative-moment support reinforcement) rather than folded into main_bar.top, since they only run a short distance from each support, not the full span.

BR2's elevation on this sheet prints 'R2' stirrup-zone markers with the same 'มากกว่า 2h' (greater than 2h from support) wording that the seismic sheets (S-10/S-11) use generically for all beams — likely this elevation is the shared template referenced by those sheets rather than a seismic-specific requirement of BR2 itself. BR2's own base stirrup spacing (from its small cross-section box) is recorded as the primary value.

RB1 and RB2's cross-sections were read by pattern-matching against B1/BR1 (150x300) and B2/BR2/RB3 (150x400) respectively, both of which are printed identically-styled and appear in the same row of small section boxes on this sheet — not independently re-verified digit-by-digit against RB1/RB2's own labels at full zoom. Flagged at reduced confidence relative to the directly-zoomed marks.
